'''Tirginni beasts''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to an unsettled desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. Roaming the deserts, the tirginni were preyed upon by [[mole serpent]]s. Noted for their distinctive odor, the tirginni's scent glands were extracted and refined to produce a [[Perfume/Legends|perfume]] marketed as [[tirginni cologne]].
